scientific_integrity.finite_computation_scope: All possible triples of the 28 explicitly verified bitangent lines, not a sample of parameter values.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit all-parameter 28-line bitangent parametrization; exhaustive symbolic factorization of all 3276 triple determinants and exact resultants, with complete reproducibility code.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: Independent validation, publication-level peer review and unrestricted generalization are not claimed.

scientific_limitations: Only smooth members of the complex Ciani pencil; the parameters -2, -1 and 2 are excluded.
Counts are the exact numbers of distinct intersections of two, three, or four bitangent lines; no classification of arbitrary quartics or topological types.
Originality is based on accessible primary-text and published-record comparisons; related unindexed classical calculations remain a risk.
title: Triple-concurrence discriminant of the Ciani quartic bitangents
